answer.reason: The verses tell two events that happened at Geba: Jonathan struck the Philistine garrison there, and Asa built it up with stones from Ramah.

clauses.english: was where Jonathan struck the Philistine garrison
clauses.quote: Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba

clauses.english: was built by King Asa with the stones and timber of Ramah
clauses.quote: king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah

doubts: 1SA 13:16 and 1SA 14:5 name Gibeah of Benjamin, a different spelling and probably another place, so I left them out.
The Levitical city, census, return and boundary verses only list the name and add nothing beyond the summary.
ISA 10:29 is a prophecy of an enemy lodging at Geba, not an event of its story, so I left it out.
